question: The first English factory was set up on the banks of the river ____________ in 1651.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hugli.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The first English factory was established in **Bengal **in the year **1651 **along the banks of the **Hugli River.**
 
• Trading in Bengal was started by the **East India **Company.
 
• The factory's **warehouse **served as a place to **store products**.
 
• The East India Company **initially visited Surat **in **1608 **in attempt to establish **trade **with India.
 
• The **Nawab **of **Bengal Siraj-Ud-Daulah** and his **French allies **were **defeated **by the **British East India Company **on **June 23, 1757,** in the **Battle of Plassey. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• In order to prepare for a future trip to the East Indies under a **royal charter**, prominent traders and explorers met in **1599**.
 
• The company featured **Sir John Wolstenholme**, **Richard Hakluyt**, a **writer **and **advocate **of **British colonisation **of the Americas, as well as a number of other **seamen **who had served with **Drake **and **Raleigh **in addition to **Fitch **and **Lancaster**.
 
• **Thomas Smythe **was a well-known **administrator **and **politician **in London whose father had established the **Levant Company**.
 
• The **battle **strengthened the Company's **hold **on **Bengal**, which over the next century expanded to include much of India.
 
• In 1696, East India Company employee **John Goldsborough **built **Fort William **in **Calcutta**.
